items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1976-02-13
items.q: The name 'John Fuhannes' does not appear in the transcript. The interviewee addresses the interviewer as 'John', but there is no evidence linking the interviewee to a person named John Fuhannes.

ctx.x: You were born here at Armin in New Orleans. And you stayed here most of your life. You haven't gone out anymore.

That's right, John. I was born on Tulane Avenue. Dick is the one that told me this because I could never find out what street I was actually born on. But he knew it was somewhere on Tulane Avenue. And finally, my present wife was looking at some of the old photographs of my mother and father. And on the back of them, very, very faint now. You can't make it out very well. But you can see 2507 Tulane that these photographs were probably penciled at that time. And I imagine that was the address, 2507 Tulane Avenue.
